summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat ran a notice for Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, at 619 Market street, offering a free concert every evening with only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, November 19, 1892, page 7. Item reads like a paid notice.

facts.fact: Allen ran his place at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with free concerts every evening

notes: Notice is entirely about Allen's establishment, so primary.
